basic_info.description: 4+ Car PRIVATE garage! Full Golden Gate Bridge view exclusive use rooftop. This rare top floor luxury residence is located on the cable car line in historic Nob Hill, on the corner of Pacific and Hyde, just minutes from downtown and the waterfront! Perched atop a grand, historic building, this residence offers a serene escape nestled among the trees with stunning Golden Gate Bridge views from your own rooftop terrace that you have the exclusive rights to further develop. This home was renovated in collaboration with Vesta Home designers and features three bedrooms (one en-suite) and two beautifully renovated, spa-inspired, designer bathrooms. Fully remodeled throughout, it also includes a private garage with lounge area and parking for up to four cars, along with generous storage space. A rare and invaluable offering in this neighborhood. Located at the iconic corner of Pacific and Hyde, right on the cable car line, you'll enjoy immediate access to a vibrant neighborhood filled with boutique shopping, acclaimed restaurants, craft cocktail bars, wine lounges, and a wealth of amenities - all just outside your doorstep. With easy access to downtown, the Marina, local parks, and the farmers market, this exceptional home places the very best of San Francisco within easy reach
